name: web-tablet-and-phone-cart-photos-with-hands-on-water-light-and-olive-shirt
title: Two rounded photos: hands holding a tablet with an add-to-cart modal against rippled light, and hands holding a phone cart against an olive shirt
whatItIs: A pale board with two rounded photographs: a woman's hands in a red shirt hold a tablet showing an added-to-cart modal with recommendations and service checkboxes over glittering white water reflections, and a man's hands in an olive shirt hold a phone with a cart, promo field, total and a blue checkout button.
whatItMeans: Human and reassuring; hands make each state feel usable.
techniques: Show hands on the device in two different settings.
Use colourful clothing as a backdrop.
Keep the UI white with blue actions.
Frame each photo as a rounded card.

vocabulary.definition: A device held by hands in a real scene.
Rippled light reflections as a backdrop.
A dialog after adding an item.
A garment used as a background.
